description: Angular component class for configuring a value card widget in the Thingsboard UI, including form setup, validation, and preview functions.

classes.name: ValueCardBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring a value card widget, extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent, managing form controls, validation, and preview functions.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group used for widget configuration.

methods.name: setupConfig
methods.description: Initializes component state based on widget configuration data.

methods.name: defaultDataKeys
methods.description: Provides default data keys for the widget.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Sets up the form with configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and saves the widget configuration based on form data.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form fields that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current configuration state.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons are enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets card button states in the configuration.

methods.name: _valuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string for the widget's value display.

methods.name: _datePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string for the date display.
